validation.applyResult: Confirmed: Synapse changed the visible CPU level from Medium to Low and emitted 0D/07 with arguments 010100.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed from the query immediately preceding the setter: 0D/87 selector 010100 returned the saved CPU component level before the transition. Subsequent exact captures established all three visible mappings.
validation.restorationResult: Confirmed visually: CPU High was returned to Medium, CPU Power Limit was returned to 60 W, CPU Voltage Optimizer was returned to On at the visible -1.000 value, GPU Overclock was returned to Off without changing either offset, and the AC profile was returned to Balanced with Auto fans.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed: component-level restoration was independently observed in the final High-to-Medium capture as 0D/07 arguments 010101. Power-limit, voltage-optimizer, and GPU-overclock restoration is visual controller evidence only and is not claimed as HID readback.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Exact PID 02C6 maps visible CPU Low, Medium, and High to raw values 00, 01, and 02. Each clean transition included the 0D/87 query form followed by the matching 0D/07 setter.
On RZ09-0528, selecting CPU High disables GPU Medium and GPU High in Synapse; GPU Low remains selectable. This constraint is model-specific and must not be generalized to PID 02E0.

With CPU Voltage Optimizer disabled, Synapse exposed a CPU Power Limit control accepting 45 through 95 W in one-watt steps. Visible transitions 60 to 45, 45 to 95, 95 to 60, 60 to 61, and 61 to 60 were operator-confirmed.
sanitizedEvidence.transportFinding: No target PID 02C6 setting transaction appeared on the verified USBPcap2 device-address-3 path. This is controller-scoped negative evidence, not proof that the setting is software-only.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Synapse exposed CPU Voltage Optimizer On with a visible value of -1.000 and range -30 through -1. Disabling it unlocked CPU preset and CPU Power Limit controls; it was restored to On after an AMD warning confirmation.
sanitizedEvidence.transportFinding: The captures contain 0D/07 writes whose payloads exactly collide with independently established CPU Medium and High preset setters. They are not admitted as optimizer commands and may be incidental preset reapplication.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Enabling GPU Overclock disclosed Synapse UI policy ranges of -1000 through +400 MHz for core and -1000 through +3000 MHz for memory. Both offsets remained at zero and GPU Overclock was restored to Off.

captures.name: GPU Overclock On to Off restoration

sanitizedEvidence.transportFinding: No target PID 02C6 setting transaction appeared. The Synapse policy bounds are narrower than the independently queried NVML driver bounds and must be exposed as exact-model policy rather than silently discarded.

productionAdmission.identityScope: RZ09-0528, BIOS 2.02, USB 1532:02C6, HID usage 0001:0002, 91-byte feature reports

limitations: OpenBlade production apply/readback had not yet been performed when this evidence annotation was authored.
CPU Power Limit, CPU Voltage Optimizer, and GPU Overclock transport/backends were not identified; visual confirmation alone is not treated as device readback.
The CPU Voltage Optimizer captures cannot distinguish optimizer behavior from CPU-preset reapplication because their 0D/07 payloads collide.
GPU clock offsets were not modified.
Raw PCAPs and unique device identifiers remain private and uncommitted.
notes: The verified transient USB device address was 3 before every session, and only USBPcap2/device 3 was captured.
All capture sessions used SkipServiceManagement and SkipAdministratorCheck, then ended by graceful timeout with no recorded capture errors.
Final visible state was Plugged In, Balanced, Auto fans, CPU Power Limit 60 W, CPU Voltage Optimizer On at -1.000, and GPU Overclock Off.
Keyboard brightness remained Off; keyboard quick effect and logo effect were Static.
